How to use a OGC processing service with python

input_project_url.title: URL to project folder
input_project_url.description: Provide URL to zipped TxtInOut SWAT project folder. Important: Do not include the SWAT executable to that folder — AquaINFRA has integrated the executable version rev60.5.7_64rel_linux for SWAT+ and rev688_64rel_linux for SWAT2012.

lulc_changes_csv_url.title: URL to csv listing HRU LULC changes
lulc_changes_csv_url.description: CSV file composed of 2 columns, first column must contain HRU ids, second column must contain the new Land Use Land Cover (LULC) to be assigned to the HRU. Note that LULCs used must be present in the plants.plt file. See format example: https://github.com/AmandaBatlle/AquaINFRA_CaseUse_MedInlandModel/blob/main/example_inputs/lulc_changes.csv

updated_txtinout.title: Updated TxtInOut
updated_txtinout.description: TxtInOut directory with updated hru-data.hru file, including new assigned LULC values in column lu_mgt for the selected HRU.
